title: SC05-T1 — the sister (SH01, SH02, SH03, SH04a, SH04b, SH05, SH06)
line: Michelle, open the door. I brought wine and I am not leaving. / ...Oh, honey. Look at you. Come here. / I am fine, Rosa. I am. / I just... I do not know who that woman in the mirror is anymore. / He looked at me like a stranger the day he left, and lately so do I.
motionPlan: Michelle shuffles down the hall to the front door as Rosa's voice calls through it; she opens the door → Rosa in the doorway holds up the bottle of red wine (held by its neck), sees Michelle's face, and her grin softens → Rosa steps in and takes Michelle's chin in her hand, tilting her tired face up to the hall light → Michelle says it, eyes sliding away from Rosa's, toward the round mirror on the wall → Michelle says it, eyes sliding away from Rosa's, toward the round mirror on the wall → Michelle turns to the round mirror over the console and looks at herself as she says it; Rosa behind her → Rosa listens, her eyes wet, nodding once, and sets the wine on the console
note: Waits for the plates, the cards and the voice masters to be confirmed, then one call (§24K part 5).
